propositions: Create an immutable OperationSnapshot type with validated non-secret effective config values, explicit source-kind provenance, selected repository root, and serializable envelope version.

Implement central OperationSnapshot composer that applies five-layer precedence (explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default) and independently selects repository root.
Thread the snapshot in shadow mode (disabled by toggle REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW) through CLI, library, MCP, and direct reconciler entry points without altering execution behavior.

Ensure snapshot construction never includes live auth objects, secret wrappers/values, provider clients, source-file paths, or subprocess environments in fields, serialization, fingerprints, or diagnostics.

Malformed selected operation config raises existing typed config error before lock/network/write effects; other snapshot assembly failures emit redacted warnings and preserve authoritative legacy operation output.
